name: Beijing Tricolor Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Beijing Tricolor Technology Co., Ltd manufactures and sells professional audio and video system solutions in China and internationally. The company offers matrix switcher, video wall controller, KVM switches, signal transceiver and extenders, conference system, and accessories, as well as customized services. Its products have applications in command-and-control centers, smart conference rooms, commercial applications, and other multimedia video scenes in various industries. Beijing Tricolor Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
